input.quote: Thereafter, this Agreement shall automatically renew for subsequent one (1) year periods unless either party provides the other party with written notification at least thirty (30) days prior to the expiration of the initial five (5) year term or any one (1) year renewal thereof of its intention to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 11.1 provides automatic renewal in successive one (1) year terms, exitable by either party (including Corio) on only thirty (30) days' written notice before the end of the initial term or any renewal term. The non-renewal notice window is 30 days, well inside the fallback ceiling of 60 days (and inside the preferred 30-day opt-out), and renewal terms are 12 months, so the walk-away triggers (windows over 90 days or automatic multi-year renewals) are not present. No renewal-period price uplift mechanic exists anywhere: Exhibit B fixes MarketSite.net and Maintenance and Support fees for "Year 2-5, and beyond", and Section 4.2 continues maintenance at the Exhibit B fees, so the conditional price-increase cap element is not triggered. The clause therefore sits at or above the fallback and is acceptable. The only shortfall against preferred wording is the absence of a Vendor reminder at least 60 days before renewal, which is a minor sub-element we note but do not redline; we would raise it only if a renewal reminder becomes commercially important.
